lines.zh: 我扇着宽大的翅膀飞过。
lines.en: I fly past on broad wings.
I glide between the treetops.

lines.zh: 我一下一下地拍着翅膀。
lines.en: I beat my wings, stroke by stroke.
I fly along the forest path.

lines.zh: 风托着我，我不用太用力。
lines.en: The wind holds me; I needn't work hard.
I fly from this tree to that one.
I swing around a bush.
My wings shine in the light.
I fly low over the flower patch.
I head for the sunlit places.
I rise a little to clear the branches.

lines.zh: 我绕着这棵老树飞第三圈。
lines.en: I fly a third lap around this old tree.

lines.zh: 我朝那片绒球葱飞过去。
lines.en: I fly toward that patch of allium.
My flight is fast and steady.
I settle lightly on a leaf.
I take off again and go on.
I rest on a flower and sip nectar.
My wings open and close.

lines.zh: 日头正高，是我飞的时候。
lines.en: The sun is high; this is my hour to fly.
I rest my feet on a leaf.
This flower is sweet.
I spread my wings and bask a while.
The wood is quiet.
I hear bees in the distance.
I wait for the wind to drop before opening my wings.
My antennae stir slightly.

lines.zh: 我停在枝上，像一片彩纸。
lines.en: I rest like a scrap of colored paper.
I know this wood well.

lines.zh: 你在我下面，我飞得很高。
lines.en: You're below me; I fly high.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞了两圈，翅风扑脸。
lines.en: I circle you twice, wing-wind on your face.
Have you brought a net out?

lines.zh: 我停在离你很近的花上。
lines.en: I land on a flower close to you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀很大，你看清了。
lines.en: My wings are large; you see them clearly.
Stay still and I might come closer.

lines.zh: 你手上没有花蜜的甜味。
lines.en: There is no nectar sweetness on your hands.
I pass above your shoulder.
You look up, but I go lower.
I circle once above your head.
A crease was pressed into my wing.
I dropped a little height.

lines.zh: 我斜着飞，翅膀一时找不准风。
lines.en: I fly askew; my wings cannot find the wind.
A few flecks of dust fell from my wings.
I land on a leaf to recover.
I beat slowly, testing flight again.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，但我还能飞。
lines.en: Not light, but I can still fly.
I fly all crooked.
I hide deep in the flowers.
I remember your hand.
That flower smells sweet.
I fly over slowly.
Is that allium? I want it.
I land and sip once.
The petals are soft and easy to stand on.
This nectar will last a day's flight.
Hold it up; I'll try.
I'm not afraid of you, only thinking of the flower.
My wings beat slowly.

lines.zh: 我这么大一只，停在绒球葱上。
lines.en: This large, I settle on an allium head.
Your bump knocked me off course.
My wing brushed your hand.
I beat my wings and rise quickly.
My wings are thin; don't press.
I fly between your fingers.
I land back on the twig and rest.

lines.zh: 这一碰，有粉落在你手上。
lines.en: That touch left dust on your hand.
I roll once and steady myself.
You nearly crushed my wing.
I retreat above the bushes.
Another great butterfly comes flying.
We circle each other in the air.
Its wings are even broader than mine.
We rise together, then descend.
I wait by the treetop for it.
Our wingtips almost touch.

lines.zh: 这片林子适合留下后代。
lines.en: This wood is good for our offspring.

lines.zh: 我们并排落在同一朵花上。
lines.en: We settle side by side on one flower.
The wind parts us and joins us again.

lines.zh: 阳光把我们的影子叠在一起。
lines.en: The sun overlaps our shadows.
I land on it and sniff.
I don't come to pick things up.

lines.zh: 前足碰了碰，只是块硬壳。
lines.en: My foreleg touches it — only a hard shell.
It's too hard; I can't sip it.
I take off and leave it.
Nectar is my aim.
There's a trace of sweetness on it.
I circle it once.

lines.zh: 这么大的翅，风也推得动。
lines.en: Wings this big still move with the wind.
I return to the flowers.
That patch of flowers looks fine.
My antennae catch the fragrance.
That flower is fully open.
I choose this patch.

lines.zh: 距离不远，一下就飞到了。
lines.en: Not far; one flight reaches it.
I see that clump of wild onion blooms.
Its color stands out.
This is what I'm looking for.
The flower is just below.
Good, this one.
I circle the flower half a turn.
I'm judging where to land.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，翅尖碰到空气。
lines.en: I'm close; my wingtips catch the air.

lines.zh: 我把六足收到腹下，对准落点。
lines.en: I tuck my six legs under and aim for the landing.
This flower holds enough nectar.
I slow my wings and sink lower.
I've seen the landing spot.
One more move and I land.
I stretch my legs forward.
I'm standing steady now.
I descend and step lightly.
One sweep of my wing.
I push with a foreleg.
Pollen scatters around.
I take off, clear of your hand.
That was light as wind.
I touch a petal and back away.
I don't fight; I only take nectar.
I fan up a small breeze.
You missed again.

lines.zh: 我从蛹里出来了，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: I've emerged, wings still soft.
I spread my wings and fly for the first time.
A common birdwing, in the wood.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比一般的蝶大。
lines.en: My wings are larger than most.
I made one turn above the treetops.

lines.zh: 阳光让我的翅膀亮起来。
lines.en: The sun lights up my wings.
The flowering season has come to this wood.
I rise from under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我落在最高的一朵花上。
lines.en: I settle on the highest flower.
My big wings make a breeze.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的翅膀卷了边。
lines.en: Fire curls the edges of my wings.
I'm struck down onto the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 翅膀沾了水，我飞不起来了。
lines.en: Wet wings; I can't lift off.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹得翻了好几个圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me over and over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膜，破了个圆孔。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my wing membrane, leaving a round hole.
The light leaves me unable to tell direction.

lines.zh: 找不到花，我飞得越来越慢。
lines.en: With no flowers, my flight grows slower.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的翅膀都僵了。
lines.en: A flash of lightning stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 没有风托着，我的大翅成了累赘。
lines.en: With no wind beneath, my huge wings are a burden.
